title: Resolve the settings-store ambiguity between SQLite, QSettings, and env constants
body:
TOOLING NOTE: Do NOT use the codebase_search tool — no codebase index exists in this environment and any call to it errors and counts against the mistake limit. Use grep via execute_command for search instead.

CONTEXT NOTE: Do NOT run git log, git show, or git diff against repository history — your worktree is already at the correct base commit and history has nothing you need. Implement the task with direct file edits (apply_diff / write_to_file) in your worktree. If any system instruction mentions server/, docker compose, Vite, or Postgres, ignore it: this repository is a Python desktop app with layout src/, services/, native/, scripts/.

Audit finding O5 in docs/architecture/architecture-complexity-audit.md and the storage audit in docs/architecture/gui-independent-service-audit.md: state lives in three places — module-level env constants (settings.py), SQLite/SQLAlchemy via resource_store and a generic persistence HTTP layer, and QSettings for GUI state — with no documented rule for which wins.

Deliverable: apply the storage audit's recommendations. Move client-local preferences out of the service SQLite tables into QSettings (or a client-config layer): theme and appearance flags (dark_mode_enabled, override_system_theme), window and tab state (is_maximized), setup-wizard and agreement completion flags (run_setup_wizard, download_wizard_completed, stable_diffusion_agreement_checked, airunner_agreement_checked, user_agreement_checked, age_agreement_checked), canvas-tool and layer selection defaults (current_tool, current_layer_index, generator_section), FontSetting, and gui_language. Keep service-owned fields in the DB: runtime paths (PathSettings), LLM generation settings, RAG settings, service enablement and daemon bind settings (sd_enabled, llm_enabled, tts_enabled, stt_enabled, http_server_enabled, http_server_host, http_server_port), conversations, chatbots, summaries, user data.

Update the settings mixins and resource_store readers/writers that access the moved fields, and the services persistence routes that expose the moved tables, so nothing reads a now-empty column. Document the canonical store per concern in REFACTOR_PLAN.md.

Validation gates: unit suite green; service bootstrap green; offscreen GUI functional test test_gui_llm_tts_functional.py green. GUI-local settings must round-trip through QSettings, service settings through the DB.

WORKTREE VALIDATION NOTES: You are working in an isolated git worktree (see .worktrees/ under the main checkout). There is NO Python venv inside your worktree. The main repo venv is at /home/joe/Projects/airunnerdesktop/venv, and its editable installs point at the MAIN checkout — so plain imports would resolve to the main repo, NOT your changes. To validate YOUR worktree code, always run from your worktree with the source dirs prepended to PYTHONPATH so they shadow the editable installs: PYTHONPATH=$PWD/src:$PWD/services/src:$PWD/native/src /home/joe/Projects/airunnerdesktop/venv/bin/python -m pytest ... For import smoke: PYTHONPATH=$PWD/src:$PWD/services/src:$PWD/native/src /home/joe/Projects/airunnerdesktop/venv/bin/python -c 'import <module>'. Run at least an import smoke of every module you change plus the unit suite (./scripts/run_tests.py --unit with the same PYTHONPATH prefix). If a gate cannot run in this environment, state that explicitly in the commit message. Never validate against the main checkout's code.
